research.title: ESPN’s Jimmy Pitaro on the New Playbook for Sports Fans
research.summary: The launch of ESPN’s direct-to-consumer service a year ago was a marker of change in the sports media business—offering the full suite of ESPN networks without a pay-TV bundle for the first time. ESPN Chairman Jimmy Pitaro joins Dave Dase, global co-head of the Sports franchise in Investment Banking, and discusses how this challenging decision helps the company reach younger viewers and “serve the sports fan anytime, anywhere.” Pitaro also talks about the strength of ESPN’s current sports rights portfolio, why the company is sometimes willing to walk away from media rights negotiations, and explains how AI allows ESPN to create new offerings.
